SELECT a.category, a.completion_rate, b.engagement_rate FROM (SELECT cd.category AS category, AVG(completion_rate) AS completion_rate FROM play_detail pd JOIN content_dim cd ON pd.content_id = cd.content_id GROUP BY cd.category) a JOIN (SELECT cd.category AS category, (SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'like' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'comment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'play' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS engagement_rate FROM user_behavior_fact ubf JOIN content_dim cd ON ubf.content_id = cd.content_id GROUP BY cd.category) b ON a.category = b.category

SELECT cr.creator_id, cd.name, SUM(cr.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM creator_revenue cr LEFT JOIN creator_dim cd ON cr.creator_id = cd.creator_id GROUP BY cr.creator_id, cd.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT c.content_id, c.title, SUM(vr.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM video_revenue vr JOIN content_dim c ON vr.content_id = c.content_id GROUP BY c.content_id, c.title ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS active_creator_count FROM user_retention u INNER JOIN creator_dim c ON u.user_id = c.creator_id WHERE u.is_active = 1 AND u.stat_date = (SELECT MAX(stat_date) FROM user_retention);
SELECT stat_date, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS dau FROM user_retention WHERE is_active = 1 GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT creator_id, stat_date, revenue FROM creator_revenue WHERE stat_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) ORDER BY creator_id, stat_date LIMIT 1000

SELECT m.date, m.category, ROUND(COALESCE(m.total_comments / NULLIF(m.total_plays, 0), 0), 4) AS comment_rate FROM metric_daily m WHERE m.date >= (SELECT MAX(date) FROM metric_daily) - INTERVAL 6 DAY ORDER BY m.category, m.date;
SELECT stat_date, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS dau FROM user_retention WHERE stat_date >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 6 DAY AND stat_date <= CURDATE() AND is_active = 1 GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date;

SELECT vr.content_id, cd.title, SUM(vr.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM video_revenue vr LEFT JOIN content_dim cd ON vr.content_id = cd.content_id WHERE vr.stat_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AND CURDATE() GROUP BY vr.content_id, cd.title ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5;
